findings.title: the confirmation interval was not used to adjust the design
findings.detail: every completed phase's declared window is checked against the 2024-01-01 boundary. This is what the lab can verify about ITSELF; it says nothing about the supplied presets, which is the next finding

findings.title: the supplied presets were tuned on the full sample
findings.detail: no interval of this dataset is an untouched holdout, because the presets' tuning cutoff is unknown. The USER_PRESET_REFERENCE control is the only arm that touches them and it is labelled retrospective; every other arm deploys selections made inside development

findings.title: the account was charged half the registered one-way taker fee
findings.detail: the registered ONE-WAY rate is passed into an engine parameter documented as ROUND-TRIP, so the engine halves it. Present in every phase from LAB-04 onward
findings.direction: flattering: absolute returns are overstated. The contrasts move only through turnover differences between arms, which is measured in the AS_DECLARED panels

findings.title: the pinned loader disagrees with the bytes on volume
findings.detail: MarketDataLoaderBase._normalize casts volume to int64 and BTC/ETH/BNB store fractional quantities. The lab reads the byte-copied parquet directly and never calls the loader, so no lab result carries the defect -- it is recorded because anyone reproducing this through the loader would get different bars

findings.title: closed metrics partitions drifted upstream
findings.detail: reading both files proves every measured column identical; only ingested_at moved, because the collector re-ingests closed months. The drifted product feeds the G3 cohort, which no phase reads

findings.title: the LAB-07 leakage audit
findings.detail: availability ordering, warm-bar gating, the exit fixed point, and the four parity surfaces

findings.title: causality of the state tape
findings.detail: every emission carries available_at, and a decision reads only the emission whose available_at is at or before it

findings.title: the confirmation model's first training window reaches into development
findings.detail: a model deployed on the first day of the interval refits on the history that existed then, which is development data. That is backward-looking and is what a deployment does; it would be leakage only if a model trained on data AFTER its own cutoff, and the fitter's mutation test covers that

findings.title: the protocol declares 1-minute execution bars and the account resolves protection on the decision bar
findings.detail: a stop and a take-profit inside the same 15-minute bar are resolved by the engine's ordering rule rather than by the minute path. Guide 4.3 asks for two cohorts when the resolution changes; neither is built, and the gap is recorded with the per-alpha exposure (COR-17, OP-19)
findings.direction: level only. Every arm and every control runs on the same frame through the same engine, so the resolution cancels in B-A, C-A, D-B and D-C

findings.title: the confirmation selector's first training window reaches into development
findings.detail: the selector at the interval's first cutoff trains on the 180 days before it, which are development data -- exactly as the calendar arm's first development fold trained from 2020-07-05. It is backward-looking, it is identical for the calendar and the dynamic arms, and it would be leakage only if a cutoff trained on data AFTER itself. The window bounds in cells[].notes.*_cutoff_evidence record each one

findings.title: the fitter's own group ablation for the confirmation role is not in-interval

measured.fitter_window: the FIRST cutoff's training window, which for this role is 2023-01-01..2024-01-01 -- development data

findings.detail: the fitter runs guide 8.3's ablation where LAB-05 chose K, on the first cutoff. For the confirmation role that is development. The descriptive claim therefore rests on scripts/ablate_lab09_states.py, which measures it on the LAST cutoff's window, entirely inside the interval

rule: a finding whose artifact is missing, or whose measured fields all resolve to null, is UNVERIFIED -- never dropped and never assumed clear
